observations_considered: Generation 8A repaired execution so that all 16 raw triads are run, and rule-aware symmetry is analysis after the fact. That repair stands.
The Generation 8A information figures are ordinary plug-in mutual information from finite tables, without a bias correction, a permutation reference, or a kernel replacement.
R00, R03, and R07 do not read the triad in their pair-event rule. Their exact initial-context and full-mask current-context information on pair observables is a structural zero.

The baseline first-destination plug-in is about 0.031 to 0.043 nats, and the largest uniform-raw cell is R03 star at about 0.0702 nats. R03 is one of those structural zeros, so that cell cannot be read as a routing effect until it is calibrated.
Checkpoint pair-class plug-in values stay near 0.12 nats through pair event 512. Persistence of the plug-in number is not persistence of information when the exact value on the controls must be zero.

Current-context plug-in information given the full pair mask is about 0.018 nats on the controls and about 0.030 to 0.036 nats on triad-conditioned rules. The first figure matches the scale of a finite-table bias.
reason: The state space has 1024 states and the transition law is known, so the information in the law can be calculated. Permutation calibrates the estimator that Generation 8A actually reported. New trajectories would repeat the same estimator.
